evidence: Grant Hackett was a swimmer at the FINA event. A clerical error initially posted his result as a loss. The error originated from a transposition in the manual results entry system, where Hackett's finishing position was inadvertently swapped with that of a swimmer in an adjacent lane. The corrected and official result for his performance was a win. The correction was issued within seventy-two hours of the original posting and was accompanied by a formal memorandum from the FINA Technical Swimming Committee. Hackett, who held the world record in the 1500m freestyle from 2001 to 2012, had entered the FINA event as the top-seeded competitor based on his season-best time of 14:34.56.
